clips.name: idle_h
clips.note: fighting-stance idle (v1 5.3-7.3 s, f560): knees a little bent, torso 12-14 degrees forward, slow breathing and a weight shift from hip to hip; the crescents and flakes bob (phase), the crest sways

clips.name: step_h
clips.note: short strafing step (0.1-0.15 b/t, the module moves the anchor): two light steps in place, hooves lifted 0.3 b, the body dips on each contact and leans over the stance leg

clips.name: run_h
clips.note: burst-run (0.6-0.8 b/t for about 5 t, v1 23.13-23.40 s): two bounding strides, body 30 degrees forward, fans swept back, crescents trailing; each hoof lands ahead of the hips (2, 6), is pushed back under her (3, 7) and leaves the floor behind her (4, 0), a short flight between the strides

clips.name: back_h
clips.note: backing off at walking pace (the anchor moves back): two steps, each hoof lifted and set down behind, torso a little more upright, eyes on the player

clips.name: turn_h
clips.note: after groggy (v4 27.0-27.5 s): the module turns the anchor (mv/turn, 9 degrees per tick); the clip steps her round from the drooped groggy stance into the fighting stance, crescents still hidden for chain_reform

clips.name: kick_combo
clips.note: H1 달빛 발차기: burst-run with the knee chambered (0-5), plant, the rising kick whips up to vertical (hit1 8) and carries her over in a backflip (9-16), settle, two sideways hops with the kicking leg stretched back (22, 28), leap (32) into a horizontal flying kick (34), leg raised overhead (36), diagonal axe kick to her front-right (hit2 40), landing (44)

clips.name: kick_jump
clips.note: H2 달빛 점프: the crescent chain lines up at her left (tell 0-13), pivot, 360 degree low sweep with the left leg at knee height (13-19), recovery, spiral jump with two rising turns (33-44), the orb forms at her raised right foot (45, disc = orb) as she tips into a forward somersault, axe kick down (52), impact 55, landing 59

clips.name: dash_kick
clips.note: H3 달빛 돌진: mote charge in a gathering crouch (0-8), coil side-on with the kicking leg cocked (8-10), dash low and stretched (10-12, the module moves the anchor 5-6 b), high side kick with the crescent on the shin (kick 15), one full turn with the leg out (ring 19), landing (22) and recovery

clips.name: vacuum
clips.note: H4 광폭한 진공: low cat-like crouch, the kicking leg glows (0-8), glint (9), rear-up with the leg raised high (12-14), stomp (16) launches the vertical blade (17), high slow backflip 17-34 (apex 2.6 b), landing crouch (38)

clips.name: groggy_h
clips.note: groggy (300 t in the pattern, v4 11.45-26.60 s): the module turns the body away from the player; she stands slack, torso 6 degrees forward, head low, fans drooped, crescents hidden, a slow sway; the flakes drift

clips.name: entrance
clips.note: hidden inside the cocoon prop until the burst at 79 (rig/prop/cocoon); revealed curled 3.6 b up, she drops with a slight tumble, lands in a wide crouch at 90 with the crescents spread and stands up by 106

clips.name: transform
clips.note: human -> butterfly: the cocoon glow (core) while she sinks and rises, the folded flat-lime wing panels behind the shoulders at 4 (form switch), core flash 5, light sphere at 6 (달빛 고치 is applied there), the wings unfold over 8 t (4-12) while she lifts into the hover, ripple rings 9, fully spread 12, element look from 14, one big settling flap

clips.name: idle_b
clips.note: hover flap (22 t): forewing ±14 degrees, hindwing 2.5 t behind at 60 %, ribbons 4 t behind, body bob ±0.12 b rising on the downstroke, legs and fans trail the beat

clips.name: glide_b
clips.note: gliding travel (model.md §5.1): body pitched 16 degrees forward, wings held swept back 30 degrees with a small flutter, legs trailing, ribbons streaming and waving

clips.name: wing_strike
clips.note: B1 우아한 날개: lift with one big flap (0-7), bank 80 degrees with the left wing hanging as a blade (8-11), swoop low past the player (12-14, the module glides 7 t from dive 8), the wing edge sweeps through at hit 15, pull-up and climb to 3 b, fluttering rolls and quick flaps, back to the hover

clips.name: wing_barrage
clips.note: B2 화염 날개의 습격 (Pyro look): four spinning wing swings at 5/31/69/94, each after a 5 t wind-up (body turned 75 degrees away, wings swept back); one full turn with the wings flung wide throws the 5 fire crescents (s+2..s+6); swings 1 and 3 spin on a diagonal, 2 and 4 flat; alternating directions; hover flaps between

clips.name: flap_dive
clips.note: B3 날개 휩쓸개 (Pyro look): wings V-up and lean back (tell 0-6), big downstroke (6-11), upstroke (11-15), rise with the wings closed above her (15-20), head-first dart dive (20-25), wing slam forward-down at 26, flame fan 28-32, low glide banked to her right (33-43), settling flaps

clips.name: coco
clips.note: B4 달빛 축복: wings to flat (0-4), the wings curl forward into a ring round the chest core (wrap 5-15, charge), snap open (16-18), orb 1 at 19 (rig/prop/orb), the cocoon ball: wings wrapped round her curled body (30-42; prop/pod optional), open (42-45), orb 2 from her side with a twist (46), recovery to the hover

clips.name: release
clips.note: B5 달빛 해제: wings closed up (fold 0-5), dart swoop past the player (5-9), climb (9-14), whirl: two cartwheel turns with the wings flung and flicking (18-30), cup (31), flash 35, X glint 37, ring cage 38-43, pod wrap while she sinks (44-52), snap open (52), DETONATION 53 with the wings flung wide and the ribbons streaming, hover 2 b up with slow beats (63-87), the wings shrink and go flat lime (87), shatter (91), the human form drops (92) and lands (96); the form switches to human at 92

clips.name: revert
clips.note: butterfly -> human without the blast: hover rising to 2 b with slow flaps, the wings shrink (30), go flat lime (32) and shatter (36), the human form drops (37) and lands (43); the form switches to human at 37

clips.name: death
clips.note: from either form: she staggers back while the wings go flat lime and shrink away over the 10 t blend (shatter 10), staggers forward, the knees buckle (20), she sinks to one knee (30), the crescents and flakes fade (30-64), then dissolves into the rising motes (scale out about her hips, 50-100); call kill after 100

clips.name: chain_reform
clips.note: the crescent chain re-forms after groggy: the four plates fly in from around her (scale 0 -> 1) and stack into a vertical chain at her left (stack 6, the thud), a small flourish, then they take their idle places

cocoon.note: the entrance cocoon (3.8 b tall, wrapped wing plates, a glowing lime window, a lime spike) and its glow halo (billboard centre); the module hides it at the burst

pod.note: the wrapped wing pod (코코볼 ball, 달빛 해제 wrap; 3.4 b tall, r 1.4 b) centred on the execution point

orb.note: the 달빛 축복 orb: a 1.7 b lime glass sphere and two gyroscope rings (spin them with transformation keys)

objectives.bfRigT: tick within the clip (anchor; -1 = queued by play)
objectives.bfRigFlat: 1 while a clip shows the temporary flat look
